dedupe_keys.name: swiss dwellings 42 207 apartment models with viewshed daylight noise and layout simulations

description: Swiss Dwellings contains detailed models of 42,207 apartments with 242,257 rooms in 3,093 buildings, with geometry, room typology and simulated visual, acoustic, topological and daylight characteristics. It was published on Zenodo on 20 September 2022 (version 1.0.0) by Matthias Standfest and colleagues at Archilyse AG, from building plans of the company's commercial clients converted to geo-referenced, semantically annotated models with manual quality checks (median area deviation 1.2 percent). The geometry file holds about 1.2 million walls and railings, 550,000 windows and doors, 400,000 areas and 240,000 sanitary and kitchen features; the simulation file gives 367 columns per area covering viewshed, natural light, traffic noise, centrality and geometry. Coverage: apartments in Switzerland from the provider's client portfolio. Access: two CSV files on Zenodo (0.8 and 1.5 GB). Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: a client-based sample, not a census, and coordinates are local to each site. Simulation uses: indoor layout for evacuation and occupancy models, daylight and noise exposure, and floor-plan learning. Related records: the Lower Saxony building dataset and ROBOD.
